h.Existe um lugar no Google que vale mais: There's a spot on Google worth more than any ad: the local pack — that block with the little map and three highlighted businesses that appears at the top when a search has "near me" intent. Most people pick one of those three and never scroll down. Being there means being in front of the customer at the exact moment they want to buy.
h.A pergunta deste artigo: como rankear no: The question this article answers: how do you rank in local Google results and get into that top 3 on the map?
h.Ponto de partida: antes de otimizar qual: Starting point: before optimizing anything, see what position you hold today in your area and who's in the top three. Get the free diagnosis — it takes 30 seconds and shows exactly who's ahead of you.
h.O próprio Google diz, na documentação of: Google itself says, in its official documentation, that local ranking is based on three things: relevance, distance and prominence. Understanding each one takes the guesswork out of the game.
h.Relevância — o quanto seu perfil \"combi: Relevance — how well your profile "matches" what the person searched for. It depends on the right category, the services listed and the words that appear on your profile and in your reviews.
h.Distância — quão perto você está de onde: Distance — how close you are to where the person is (or to the area they typed). You don't control the customer's location, but you do control how Google understands your service area.
h.Destaque (proeminência) — o quão conheci: Prominence — how well-known and active your business is in Google's eyes. This is where reviews weigh the most: quantity, rating and recency are the main prominence signal for a local business.
h.Categoria principal certa — a mais espec: The right primary category — as specific as possible (e.g. "Pizza restaurant" instead of "Restaurant"). And add whatever secondary categories make sense.
h.Nome, endereço e telefone (NAP) exatos e: Name, address and phone (NAP) exact and up to date.
h.Serviços e atributos preenchidos (delive: Services and attributes filled in (delivery, accepts cards, accessible, etc.).
h.Descrição com as palavras que seus clien: A description using the words your customers would use to look for you.
h.Quantidade: mais avaliações = mais desta: Quantity: more reviews = more prominence. A business with 150 reviews tends to overtake one with 15, even with a similar rating.
h.Recência: avaliações novas e constantes: Recency: new, steady reviews signal an active business. A weekly flow is worth more than an isolated spike.
h.Palavras-chave nas avaliações: quando cl: Keywords in reviews: when customers write "best all-you-can-eat pizza in the area", it reinforces your profile's relevance for that search. You don't write for them, but asking for the review right after the service increases the chance they'll mention what they had.
h.O obstáculo de sempre é a fricção: clien: The usual obstacle is friction: a happy customer won't review if it's a hassle. That's why NFC (or QR Code) stands and cards on the counter and tables work so well for local ranking — they turn the request into a single tap and keep up the steady flow of recent reviews that Google loves.
h.Categoria genérica ou errada. É o erro m: Generic or wrong category. It's the most common mistake and one of the costliest for relevance.
h.Avaliações estagnadas. Ficar meses sem r: Stagnant reviews. Going months without new reviews signals a "stalled" business, even if it's packed.
h.Tentar burlar com palavra-chave no nome: Trying to game the system with keywords in the business name or a fake address — it violates the rules and can get your profile suspended.
Local ranking doesn't change overnight. With a complete profile and a steady flow of reviews, it's normal to start seeing movement within 4 to 8 weeks, and more solid gains on the map between the third and sixth month. It's a cumulative effect: every new review adds up, and the competitor who stopped collecting falls behind.
h.Resumindo: complete o perfil, mantenha-o: In short: complete your profile, keep it active and — above all — never stop collecting recent reviews. Local ranking rewards consistency, and consistency is exactly what one-tap technology was built to guarantee.
